subject: How can I facet this histogram?

messages.author: 2b2775e2c15361c4
messages.subject: How can I facet this histogram?
parts:
Hello everyone, I have some problems with grouping the bars of my histogram.

This is part of the dataset:

"Color"   "Group"  "ID"  "Value"
blue        Group1   A1   194
red         Group1   A2   1446
blue        Group2   B1   0
red         Group2   B2   17
blue        Group3   C1   77
red         Group3   C2   2565
blue        Group3   D1   223
red         Group3   D2   61

I build the histogram as follow:

ggplot(data, aes(ID, Values)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = Color), position = "dodge", stat="identity") + scale_fill_manual(values=c("Blue", "Red"))

Now I would group the bars of the histogram by the variable Group, but I found it impossible using facet_wrap:

ggplot(data, aes(ID, Values)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = Color), position = "dodge", stat="identity") + scale_fill_manual(values=c("Blue", "Red")) + facet_wrap(. ~ Group)
Error in layout_base(data, vars, drop = drop) : 
  At least one layer must contain all variables used for facetting.

It would be just as fine having the groups spaced from each other.

How can I do that? Someone can help me?

Thank you very much,
Valentina

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: How can I facet this histogram?
parts:
I'd recommend reading http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/ and
then constructing a self-contained example. Otherwise it's hard to
figure out what's gone wrong.

(FWIW that is a _bar_ chart, not a histogram)

Hadley
